acip: DES NA SMAN BCUD KYIS LEN ZA BA BZHIN DU BSGOM PA'I LAM GYIS SA LHAG MA RNAMS SU RIM GYIS SHIN TU RAB TU RNAM PAR DAG PA'I SKAD CIG BYUNG BAS GNAS GYUR NAS, GANG GI TSE SGRIB PA MA LUS PA SPANGS PA'I MTSAN NYID DGOS PA YONGS SU RDZOGS PAR GYUR PA DE'I TSE SANGS RGYAS KYI SA LA YE SHES DE NYID DGOS PA YONGS SU GRUB PA LA DMIGS PA ZHES BYA'O,,
wylie: des na sman bcud kyis len za ba bzhin du bsgom pa'i lam gyis sa lhag ma rnams su rim gyis shin tu rab tu rnam par dag pa'i skad cig byung bas gnas gyur nas, gang gi tshe sgrib pa ma lus pa spangs pa'i mtshan nyid dgos pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi sa la ye shes de nyid dgos pa yongs su grub pa la dmigs pa zhes bya'o
english: And then it's just the same as where we learn to live on nothing more than a tiny pill made from the essence of some medicinal plant. Utilizing the path of habituation, we work our way gradually through the rest of the bodhisattva levels, transforming things with mere instants of absolute purity. At some point, we fulfill the goal characterized by eliminating each and every one of our obstacles. When we do reach this juncture, we say that this same state of wisdom, at the level of an Enlightened Being, is “focused upon final accomplishment of the goal.”
